description: Patton gate for Codex: holds a change to a file that existed when the session started until the person types approve <id>, and, when turned on, applies the discipline rules and the blind verifier at the stop.

hooks.command: { command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 && python3 -c 'import sys; sys.exit(sys.version_info < (3, 10))' >/dev/null 2>&1; } || exit 0; exec python3 "${PLUGIN_ROOT:-$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/patton_gate.py" --host codex

{ command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 && python3 -c 'import sys; sys.exit(sys.version_info < (3, 10))' >/dev/null 2>&1; } || { printf '%s\n' 'Patton gate: python3 3.10 or newer is not on PATH, so the gate cannot check this call and blocks it. Install python3 3.10 or newer, or remove the gate with: codex plugin remove patton-gate@patton-protocol' >&2; exit 2; }; exec python3 "${PLUGIN_ROOT:-$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/patton_gate.py" --host codex
